verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party doc page titled "Fingerprint Rules" under Sentry's event-grouping documentation. That implies a documented way to customize how events are grouped, but nothing in the pack describes the automatic stack-trace grouping of duplicate events into one issue, or how the rules work. Missing for 10: any description of default stack-trace-based grouping of duplicates into issues, details of how fingerprint rules override grouping, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform groups thousands of duplicate events into one issue via stack-trace fingerprinting, and I can customize the grouping when it gets it wrong
